    • FT_Bitmap_Size

      public FT_Bitmap_Size(ByteBuffer container)
      Creates a FT_Bitmap_Size instance at the current position of the specified ByteBuffer container. Changes to the buffer's content will be visible to the struct instance and vice versa.

      The created instance holds a strong reference to the container object.
